text: dsh-choice 是面向 DSH 网页聊天的单选交互插件，通过 ask_user_choice 工具发布聊天内的选择板，并由客户端把工具调用渲染成可操作的卡片。用户可从文本、图片或音频选项中选一项，也可选择末尾的“无合适选项”；选择会作为普通聊天消息发送。图片可放大预览，音频可播放，选择板提交后不能重复选择。工具立即返回，不等待用户在当前轮回答，适合需要延后收集偏好或让用户从多媒体候选中作决定的场景。无需 API 密钥或外部账号；本地媒体会复制到应用数据目录，并通过回环地址提供给网页客户端。

dsh-choice adds single-choice boards to DSH web chat. The ask_user_choice tool shows text, image, or audio options and a “none” row. A pick is sent as a chat message; images can be enlarged and audio played. The tool returns immediately. Local media uses loopback; no API key is needed.
想让 DSH 在聊天里给用户一个可点击的单选列表。
我需要用户从几张图片或几段音频里选一个，能在聊天中完成吗？
Can I show clickable choices in chat and let the user answer later without blocking the current turn?
dsh-choice 的功能「单选板」：工具调用会在聊天中显示文本、图片或音频选项及一个“无合适选项”行。用户点击后，所选内容作为普通聊天消息发送，当前板上的其他选择随即停用。
dsh-choice 的功能「媒体预览」：选择板为图片提供点击放大的预览层，为音频提供播放和暂停按钮；本地媒体由主机服务复制并通过本地回环地址供网页读取。

dsh-choice README · dsh-choice：A single-choice board inside the DeepSeek Harness chat, next to the built-in `ask_user_question`.

```
ask_user_choice({ title, subtitle?, options, noneLabel? })
```

Every option is **text**, an **image** or a **sound**. The card is posted as a normal chat
row, the user presses the check icon on one row, and the choice comes back as an ordinary
chat message that starts the next turn.

dsh-choice README · Behaviour：All visible text (title, subtitle, option titles and descriptions, `noneLabel`) comes from
the agent, in the language of the conversation.

dsh-choice README · Card：Rows: a 52 px preview (image thumbnail or ▶ button), the title and description, and the
round check button on the right. Clicking an image opens a lightbox; pressing ▶ plays the
sound with a plain `Audio` object, so there is no extra UI. A pick replaces the drafts
carefully: the composer keeps its text, the choice is sent as its own message.

dsh-choice README · Options：```jsonc
{
  "kind": "text",              // required: text | image | audio
  "title": "Keep as is",       // row label
  "description": "…",          // optional second line

Local files are copied into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-choice\media` and served over loopback.

dsh-choice README · Bridge：`127.0.0.1:49236`:

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/status` | port and media counter |
| `GET` | `/media/<file>` | served image or audio |
| `POST` | `/attach` | copy a local file and return its URL |

dsh-choice README · Install：```json
"dsh-choice": "github:machine202502/dsh-choice#main"
```

and add `dsh-choice` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. A restart is required for the host half to
load; the client half reloads with the page.
